note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each of the five wards of Londonderry Corporation; nominations Thursday 5 January, poll Monday 16 January 1928. Only the North Ward was contested, where Councillor H. N. Greenway, passed over by the Unionist ward committee, stood as an Independent Labour Unionist (Derry Journal, 6, 9 and 18 January 1928). Only about 400 Nationalists voted, according to the Journal; Greenway had been a councillor for the ward.
